summary: Guillermo Salas is a software engineer who became an enterprise architect and then an executive leader. Two decades in, he still builds people, develops leaders, and pushes engineering execution to a higher standard. That work started hands-on in .NET and cloud architecture, moved through director- and VP-level leadership, and now shows up in how he designs the organization, architecture, and operating model behind Experity's engineering teams. AI-assisted engineering is the newest arena for that same leadership pattern. The pattern itself repeats across CoreLogic, HSA Bank, SafeNet and SysLogic, Chronicled, and Experity: strengthen technical judgment, clarify ownership, and build leaders who can carry the work forward without him in the room.

hero.tagline: He builds stronger leaders and stronger engineering systems.
